newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Ontrack Data begun with buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Ontrack Data begun with buy.

text.p: --Dain Bosworth Inc said Friday it has begun coverage of Ontrack Data International, a computer data recovery firm, with a buy rating.
--Earnings a share for 1996 are forecast at $0.34 for 1996 and $0.45 for 1997, compared to $0.08 a share in 1995, Dain Bosworth said.

--"We believe the company has no competitor who can match Ontrack's broad experience, advanced proprietary technology, customer base and research and development," analyst Maureen Pettirossi wrote in a research report.
--Dain Bosworth estimated revenues will increase 30 percent and the Ontrack's sustainable EPS growth rate at 30-35 percent.
--One year to 18 month price target is $20, Dain Bosworth said. Ontrack shares fell 3/8 to 12-7/8 Friday on Nasdaq.
